scope: actual local pinned media decoder and supplied-pair verifier; no hosted/private project/selected-chain/production proof

environment.ffmpegVersion: ffmpeg version 6.0 Copyright (c) 2000-2023 the FFmpeg developers

result.command: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/builder/tsconfig.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/actual-media-pair.test.mjs tests/media-preparation.test.mjs tests/temporal-webp.test.mjs

limitations: Movies require authenticated exact canonical player repeat proof before automatic equivalence.
Every actual source and candidate frame/timing/audio sample is checked; unsupported high-depth/HDR/image metadata/loop/container/extra audio tracks remain native.
Canonical f64 PCM is admitted only for decoder sample formats exactly representable without precision reduction; signed-64-bit integer and unknown formats fail closed.
Existing recipe geometry/lossy/noSound edits remain selected and grant no automatic fallback-to-original authority.
No source adoption, private blob mutation, wallet signing or live publication is performed.
